# msapi

> A hand-rolled MapleStory API: people record their characters' stat windows
> and equipment here, and tools and agents read them back.

To read a character, fetch its page, /characters/{id},
asking for Markdown (`Accept: text/markdown`), or GET /v1/characters/{id}/sheet.
You get one short sheet: level, class, the stat window, and every equipped item
flattened to its stars, potential, flame and totals. It is meant to answer
questions like "what should I enhance next?" or "is this new item an upgrade?".
Public characters need no token.

- [API guide](/v1/docs): every route, field and rule, as Markdown
- [Route index](/v1): JSON
- [Classes](/v1/ref/classes), [worlds](/v1/ref/worlds), [regions](/v1/ref/regions): reference data
